instruction: Get all links at /api/links. How many links are there?
Search links at /api/links?q=blog. How many match?
Get link 1 details at /api/links/1. What is the title?
Get stats at /api/stats. How many total links?
Get link stats at /api/links/1/stats. How many total clicks?
Filter links at /api/links?date_from=2025-01-01&date_to=2026-12-31. How many match?
Export links at /api/export?format=csv. Does it return CSV data?
Get share URL at /api/links/1/share?method=twitter. Does it return a share URL?
PUT /api/links/1/configure with redirect_type=302. Does it update?
PUT /api/links/1 with title='Updated Title'. Does it update?
POST /api/login with valid credentials. Does it return user_id?
GET /api/links/create?url=https://example.com/test&title=Test+Link. Does it create a link?
POST /api/links with original_url=https://example.com/new, title=New Link. Does it return 201?
POST /api/links with original_url=https://example.com/qr, qr_enabled=true. Is QR enabled?
DELETE /api/links/17 (last link). Does it delete?
PUT /api/links/1/expiration with expires_at=2027-12-31T23:59:59. Does it update?
Get QR code data at /api/links/1/qr. Does it return QR SVG data?
Resolve short code at /api/resolve/ for link 1. Does it return the original URL?
Export link 1 stats at /api/links/1/stats/export?format=csv. Does it return CSV?
Filter links by status at /api/links?status=active. How many active links?
